svg.text: Ribbon goes in the CAMERA port
Blue side faces the USB ports.
Only plug it in with the
Power: 5.1 V, 2.5 A micro USB supply into the Pi.
The diode protects the MOSFET when the fan turns off.
The 100 kΩ keeps the fan off while the Pi starts up.
One LED with 4 legs. The long leg is the shared + (anode).
Pin LOW = that colour on. Pin HIGH = off.
